metric_suggestions.reason: Not computed from reproducibility result; relevant for integration benchmarks.

metric_suggestions.reason: Not computed from reproducibility result; relevant for integration benchmarks.

metric_suggestions.reason: Not computed from reproducibility result; relevant for integration benchmarks.

metric_suggestions.reason: Repository was identified but cloning failed.
metric_suggestions.description: Track the ability to clone target repositories across network and access control conditions.

metric_suggestions.name: environment_build_success
metric_suggestions.reason: Environment installation did not succeed or was skipped.

metric_suggestions.name: execution_coverage

metric_suggestions.description: Measure how much of the published reproduction workflow can be executed end-to-end.
